name: @hongkongkiwi/clockify-master-mcp
description: Clockify Master MCP - The most comprehensive Model Context Protocol server for Clockify time tracking with full API integration, advanced filtering, and enterprise features

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release: npm run test && npm run build && npm run publish:npm && npm run publish:jsr
scripts.version:patch: npm run ci:check && npm version patch && npm run release:trigger
scripts.version:minor: npm run ci:check && npm version minor && npm run release:trigger
scripts.version:major: npm run ci:check && npm version major && npm run release:trigger
scripts.version:prerelease: npm run ci:check && npm version prerelease && npm run release:trigger
scripts.ci:check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage
scripts.release:dry: npm run ci:check && echo 'Dry run: would create release'

author: HongKongKiwi
